title: "roundabouts"
format: html
project:
  resources:
    - "*.js"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
qatarcars <- read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2025/2025-12-09/qatarcars.csv')

qatarcars
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(r2d3)

r2d3(data = qatarcars,
     script = "bubbles_cars.js",
     d3_version = 4
     )
```


```{r}
glimpse(qatarcars)
```

```{r}
plot_data <- qatarcars |> 
  add_count(make) |> 
  # SELECT ALL COLUMNS NEEDED FOR SCENES
  select(make, model, price, horsepower, mass, performance, origin, type)

r2d3(data = plot_data, script = "scrolly_cars.js", d3_version = 4)
```

```{r}
glimpse(qatarcars |> 
  arrange(desc(price)))
```
